text:
mike_sales: Heads-up — HelioGrid exec escalated the POC. They require VPC peering + BYO-KMS, and want a throughput SLA for POC (p95 <= 150ms, sustain ~2k tokens/sec). CFO is asking for a custom monthly rate if we reserve capacity. Exec review scheduled Wed EOD. Need SRE + Security + Pricing to own immediate unblock. :exclamation:

sara_se: Ack. Can you paste the exact model + seq length and whether they need synchronous low-latency or batch? Also who from HelioGrid is on the call?

mike_sales: Model requested: redwood-3b-q4 (they said 8k context), typical sequence 512 tokens, peak burst ~200 concurrent requests. Primary contact: laura@heliogrid.com (CISO), exec sponsor: ceo@heliogrid.com. They explicitly asked for dedicated pool during POC.

raj_eng: If it's sustained 2k tokens/sec with 200 conc reqs at 512 seq, we'll likely need 2 dedicated A100-like slots with autoscale/burst. For latency we need KV cache warmup and prefix caching. Quick config snippet I’d propose to run on Dedicated:
```
instance_type: gpu.a100-80gb
pool_size: 2
autoscale: min=1,max=4
model: redwood-3b-q4
max_seq: 8192
priority: p95-latency
```
This is rough — need SRE to validate networking/peering impact.

lia_security: Thanks. Security checklist: we need completed security questionnaire + SOC2 report + proof of KMS key policy. BYO-KMS is allowed on Private but requires KMS policy review and DPA change. Also confirm VPC peering pattern (cross-account vs transit). I'll start an intake ticket and ping HelioGrid for the questionnaire. :eyes: 

mike_sales: I'll send the questionnaire link to laura and request SOC2. Can we get an exec-ready one-pager for the business/ops ask? Need to land messaging on Wed.

tess_sre: @raj_eng fyi: peering introduces additional egress hops — measured latency could increase ~10-30ms depending on path. If they require strict 150ms p95 we should consider co-locating in same region and dedicated capacity. I'll spin up a load profile test once we have network details. Assigning SRE owner: tess_sre.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-5123 "HelioGrid POC — VPC + BYO-KMS + throughput SLA" assigned to tess_sre, lia_security, and pricing-ops. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INF-5123

sara_se: Pricing ops — can we put together a preliminary POC quote (1 month) with reserved capacity + surcharge for BYO-KMS/legal addendum? Need rough numbers to share with CFO by EOD tomorrow. @pricing-ops please advise.

raj_eng: As a fallback if Private deployment delays, we can offer hosted with throttled SLAs and an automated fallback to smaller model variants. That reduces lead time but may not satisfy their security team. Recommend we present both options to the execs.

lia_security: Also flagging that BYO-KMS onboarding timeline is ~2 weeks for key escrow & policy review. If HelioGrid needs faster turn-up, suggest temp managed KMS with contractual assurances.

mike_sales: Good call. I'll confirm whether HelioGrid can accept a managed KMS for the POC. If not, they'll need to accept the 2-week onboarding. Please prepare two decks: (A) Dedicated Private w/ BYO-KMS (timeline + pricing) (B) Hosted+fallback (faster, lower security posture). Need both by Tue morning for exec sync.

ceo_jordan: Thanks team — prioritize this. If pricing needs executive exception, tag me and I'll join the customer call. Keep updates in INF-5123 and drop a brief 1-slide summary for the exec review. :thumbsup:

mike_sales: Will do. Owners: tess_sre (SRE), lia_security (Security), raj_eng (Engineering architecture), sara_se (Solutions), pricing-ops (Pricing). I'll update INF-5123 with deadlines.

sara_se: I'll draft the one-pager and quote template tonight and post in the ticket. If anyone has precedent POC pricing with BYO-KMS, drop it here or attach the spreadsheet.

raj_eng: I'll run a quick sim and post estimated GPU hours + perf numbers by EOD.

lia_security: I'll pull SOC2 and template language for the DPA addendum, and start the questionnaire request to laura@heliogrid.com.

tess_sre: Will schedule a network intake with HelioGrid's infra team — need contact for peering (laura or infra lead).

mike_sales: Thanks all. I'll book a triage call tomorrow 10am PT and invite laura + our exec if needed. INF-5123 will be the single source of truth.

deploy-bot: INF-5123 status updated -> "In progress". Assignees: tess_sre, lia_security, pricing-ops.

mike_sales: (minor) tagging @ceo_jordan because CFO asked for exec pricing approval path.

sara_se: +1. Let's try to avoid multi-day stalls. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

mike_sales: End of thread update: triage call confirmed, Tue 10am PT. I'll push helio contacts into INF-5123.
